t: 九年战争期间被荷兰轰炸的"格特".
te: The Dutch bombard Givet during the Nine Years' War.
dz: 九年战争期间被荷兰轰炸的"格特".

t: 英国长期议会解散，为新的国民公会议会做准备。
te: The Long Parliament of England is dissolved so as to prepare for the new Convention Parliament.
dz: 英国长期议会解散，为新的国民公会议会做准备。
de: The Long Parliament of England is dissolved so as to prepare for the new Convention Parliament.

t: 阿贝纳基人萨莫塞特拜访了普利茅斯殖民地的定居者并迎接他们,"欢迎英国人! 我叫萨莫塞特"
te: Samoset, an Abenaki, visits the settlers of Plymouth Colony and greets them, "Welcome, Englishmen! My name is Samoset."
dz: 阿贝纳基人萨莫塞特拜访了普利茅斯殖民地的定居者并迎接他们,"欢迎英国人! 我叫萨莫塞特"
de: Samoset, an Abenaki, visits the settlers of Plymouth Colony and greets them, "Welcome, Englishmen! My name is Samoset."

t: 在"红巾起义"中,被宋朝皇帝惠宗宣称为"后人"的汉林尔被封为"恢复了的宋朝"博州"的皇帝.
te: Amidst the Red Turban Rebellions, Han Lin'er, a claimed descendant of Emperor Huizong of Song, is proclaimed emperor of…
dz: 在"红巾起义"中,被宋朝皇帝惠宗宣称为"后人"的汉林尔被封为"恢复了的宋朝"博州"的皇帝.
de: Amidst the Red Turban Rebellions, Han Lin'er, a claimed descendant of Emperor Huizong of Song, is proclaimed emperor of the restored Song dynasty in Bozhou.

dz: 在蒙塞古尔陷落后,200多名拒绝退位的卡特人被烧死.
de: Over 200 Cathars who refuse to recant are burnt to death after the Fall of Montségur.

te: Massacre of Jews at Clifford's Tower, York.
dz: 在约克州克利福德塔屠杀犹太人.
de: Massacre of Jews at Clifford's Tower, York.

te: Western Roman Emperor Valentinian III is assassinated while practising on the Campus Martius on behalf of Petronius Max…
dz: 西罗马皇帝瓦伦丁尼安三世为佩特罗尼乌斯·马克西穆斯在Campus Martius上执教时被刺杀.
de: Western Roman Emperor Valentinian III is assassinated  while practising on the Campus Martius on behalf of Petronius Maximus.

t: 新巴比罗尼亚帝国对耶路撒冷的第一次围攻以该城向尼布甲尼撒二世国王投降而告终.
te: The first siege of Jerusalem by the Neo-Babylonian Empire ends with the city surrendering to king Nebuchadnezzar II.
